data.summary: Full Stack Developer with 3 years of hands-on experience in designing and developing enterprise applications using Angular (13+) for dynamic, responsive frontends and Java Spring Boot for scalable, high-performance backends. Strong expertise in Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, and Dependency Injection, with proven ability to build secure, efficient REST APIs and integrate with relational databases. Skilled in developing modular Angular components, RxJS-based state management, reactive forms, routing, and lazy loading for seamless user experiences. Adept at working in Agile/Scrum teams, delivering clean, maintainable code, and mentoring junior developers. Recognized for quickly adapting to new technologies, optimizing application performance, and delivering high- quality solutions that align with business goals.

raw_sections.summary: Professional Summary Full Stack Developer with 3 years of hands-on experience in designing and developing enterprise applications using Angular (13+) for dynamic, responsive frontends and Java Spring Boot for scalable, high-performance backends. Strong expertise in Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, and Dependency Injection, with proven ability to build secure, efficient REST APIs and integrate with relational databases. Skilled in developing modular Angular components, RxJS-based state management, reactive forms, routing, and lazy loading for seamless user experiences. raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS Frontend (Angular):
Angular 13+, TypeScript, RxJS, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, SCSS • Angular Forms (Reactive & Template-driven), Routing, Guards, Lazy Loading • State Management (RxJS), Custom Directives & Pipes, Component Communication • UI Frameworks: Angular Material, Bootstrap • PWA (Progressive Web Apps), Responsive Web Design
Backend (Java & Spring):
Core Java (OOPs, Collections, Streams, Exception Handling) • Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate ORM • Spring Security (JWT, OAuth2, Role-based Access Control) • Dependency Injection (DI), RESTful API Development • Database Integration: MySQL, MongoDB
Tools & Platforms:
Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Maven, Gradle, Postman, Swagger • VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse
Other Skills:
Application Performance Optimization (caching, lazy loading, query tuning) • Debugging & Troubleshooting, Agile/Scrum Methodology • Cross-browser Compatibility, Basic UI/UX Principles • Flutter (Android & iOS) – cross-platform mobile app development, state management, and deployment to Play Store & App Store
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Software Developer – Talentpace Pvt Ltd — Bangalore, India (Jan 2023 – Present)
Developed and maintained full-stack applications using Angular (13+) and Spring Boot, ensuring scalable and secure enterprise solutions.
Designed and implemented modular, reusable Angular components and integrated them with REST APIs secured by JWT, improving maintainability and security.
Built RESTful APIs with Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, and MySQL, enabling efficient data handling for large volumes of transactions.
Optimized frontend performance using lazy loading, routing strategies reducing page load times by 25%. • Developed cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter (Android & iOS) and deployed them to Google Play Store and Apple App Store, ensuring smooth performance and intuitive user experience.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams (QA, UI/UX, Product) in an Agile/Scrum environment, ensuring timely delivery of high-priority features.
Conducted code reviews, enforced clean coding practices, and mentored junior developers.
KEY ACHIVEMENTS
• Led a 4-member team to deliver critical features ahead of schedule. • Consistently delivered high-quality, defect-free code, reducing production issues significantly.
Improved API performance by 20% with optimized SQL queries and caching strategies.
KEY PROJECT Dynamic Docket – Angular, TypeScript, Spring Boot, MySQL, JPA, RxJS, Angular Material
Built reusable Angular components for workflow automation and implemented transactional REST APIs for backend processing. Improved API response time by 30% through optimized queries and caching.

Leap HUSA – Angular, TypeScript, Spring Boot, SCSS, Bootstrap, RxJS
Developed modular UI for content management system with role-based access using Spring Security. • Implemented complex Reactive Forms with server-side validation for improved data integrity.
EZEE-HR – Angular, Spring Boot, JPA, Bootstrap
Delivered HR workflow features for employee management, integrating Angular UI with secure backend endpoints.
Enhanced stakeholder satisfaction by prioritizing feature enhancements and ensuring smooth deployments.
Himalaya Cares – Flutter, Java Spring Boot, Bloc and Cubits
Built a cross-platform event registration app using Flutter for Android & iOS, enabling users to browse, register, and manage events seamlessly.
Designed intuitive and responsive UI screens with Flutter widgets, enhancing user experience and accessibility. Integrated Spring Boot REST APIs for event listings, user authentication, registration tracking, and notifications. Implemented state management for real-time updates in event registration and attendee status.


AWARD AND RECOGNITION
Guiding Star Award for consistently assisting teammates and supporting team success. • Quick Starter Award for rapid adaptation and high-quality early project delivery. • Beyond Expectations Award for proactively exceeding responsibilities and ensuring project success.
